d.why: O-ring cross-section, tolerance range in the source's table

h.why: groove depth (assembled gland height), range in the source's table

w.why: groove width, range in the source's table

laws.source: squeeze = (d - h)/d, the source's formula (section 4 and 11)
gland fill = O-ring area / groove area (round section pi d^2/4 over w*h); reproduces the source's nominal 74.8%
volume swell scales the O-ring area (source's 10% swell remark)

requirements.why: MY interpretation: 85% upper fill limit applied to the swollen fill
